g.text: a feature to add, or a defect to fix?

g.text: modules, tests, spec sections; cite each

g.text: Path A: glossary from the code's identifiers;

g.text: Path B: verify each spec section in the radius

g.title: confirm
g.text: falsifiers as one set, a mechanism each,

g.title: defect
g.text: the divergence is a defect item

g.title: roadmap
g.text: a defect names the requirement it violates
and a mechanism that reproduces it

g.title: agreement
g.text: write it, or replace the copy it holds

g.title: capture
g.text: cairn item: backlog if it fits the spec,
next-feature if it changes Agreed text;

g.title: mechs
g.text: a defect keeps its failing reproduction
